news.title: Global Market: Chinese stocks struggle near one-year lows as policy support disappoints
news.summary: Chinese blue-chip stocks stayed near one-year lows despite Beijing’s latest credit, mortgage and investment support measures. The CSI 300 was headed for its steepest quarterly decline since 2022, while property and technology shares remained under pressure. Weak domestic demand, subdued trading ahead of the holiday and limited investor confidence continued to weigh on markets.
